intentionalBreakingChanges: RouterRuntime now requires a non-null PeerEndpointPolicy.
Production public peer endpoints require HTTPS, an explicitly allowed port, and endpoint ownership authorization.
The executable currently denies all production public peer endpoints until a registry-backed authorizer is wired.
consumerActions: Implement a registry-backed IPublicPeerEndpointAuthorizer using a challenge signed by the advertised router key and bind the allowed resolved address set.
Keep production deployment blocked until the authorizer and periodic revalidation exist.
Configure only required production peer ports; the default is 443.
Continue using exact router-bound RFC1918 tuples only in the isolated UAT profile.
